The exact chance of a core/part to be hit is shown in parenthesis after its exposure/coverage on the relevant info screen. You can also press 'c' to have the main HUD's parts list display a visualization of relative coverage, i.e. longer bars represent a greater chance for a given part to be hit.

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Enemy robots work the same way, so the more parts you blow off, the more likely you are to hit and destroy their core. Armor plating has a very high coverage, so it's more likely to be hit, while tiny utilities such as embedded processors have very low coverage, so you can expect them to last much longer (unless you have little or nothing else covering you). As you progress, your core will become more and more protected by attached parts, because you'll have many more of them, but by that time there are other dangers such as system corruption.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 敌对机器人也遵循相同规则，所以你拆掉的部件越多，击中并摧毁其核心的几率就越高。装甲覆盖率很高，因此更容易被击中；嵌入式处理器等小型工具覆盖率很低，所以往往能存活更久（除非你几乎没有其他部件保护自己）。随着进度推进，你会安装更多部件，使核心得到越来越周全的保护；但那时也会面临系统腐化等其他危险。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: When a part is destroyed by damage that exceeds its remaining integrity, the surplus damage is then applied directly to the core or another part as chosen by standard coverage/exposure rules. Critical strikes that outright destroy a part can still cause overflow if their original damage amount exceeded the part's integrity anyway. Damage overflow is caused by all weapons except those of the "gun" type, and can overflow through multiple destroyed parts if there is sufficient damage.

Some weapons lower the value (most notably ballistic cannons), others have no meaningful effect on it (most guns), while certain types may even raise it, ultimately increasing the likelihood of retrieving useful salvage.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 机器人被摧毁后能留下多少可回收物，取决于其累计“回收修正值”，该值反映此前遭受的一切影响。该内部值初始为零，每枚击中机器人的投射物都会根据武器为总值贡献回收修正。有些武器会降低该值（尤其是弹道加农炮），有些几乎不影响（多数枪械），某些类型甚至会提高该值，增加回收到有用残骸的几率。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: The chance for the robot's parts to survive, checked individually for each part, is ([percent_remaining_integrity / 2] + [salvage_modifier]), thus more damaged parts are more likely to be destroyed completely along with the robot. If the robot has any residual heat, parts can be melted, the chance of which is ([heat - max_integrity] / 4), so again less likely to affect large parts (though still possible, especially at very high heat levels). If the robot was corrupted, parts can be "fried," the chance of which is [system_corruption - max_integrity]; by the numbers, this will generally only affect small electronic components like processors, and sometimes devices. Each salvageable part left by a corrupted robot also has a corruption% chance to itself be corrupted, specifically by a random amount from 1 to (10*[corruption]/100), and when attached will increase Cogmind's system corruption by the same value as well as possibly cause another side effect. In cases where a robot's system corruption significantly exceeded 100 at the time of destruction, a single part's corruption is capped at 15.

X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 17. 若未命中核心或触发链式反应，则准备对目标部件造成伤害。若该部件是相位装甲或有启用的相位偏转器，先按其效果降低伤害，并将减免量记为[transferredCoreDamage]供后续使用；然后，若为动力装甲且能源足够，则消耗能源降低伤害；若为正处于攻城模式的履带，也按相应方式减伤。部件未被摧毁时，还会在适用情况下检查是否受到电磁扰乱。

X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 18. 若部件因伤害被摧毁，记录所有超额伤害作为溢出。若部件被暴击直接摧毁，但伤害本来也超过其完整度，超额伤害仍会记作溢出。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: 19. If part was not armor and the attack was via cannon, launcher, or melee, transfer remaining damage to another random target (forcing to a random armor if any exists). Continue transferring through additional parts if destroyed (and didn't hit armor).
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 19. 若目标部件不是装甲，且攻击来自加农炮、发射器或近战，则将剩余伤害转移给另一个随机目标（若有装甲，则强制随机选择一件装甲）。若该部件被摧毁且不是装甲，则继续向其他部件转移。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: 20. If part not destroyed, check whether heat transfer melts it instead.

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: 22. Apply damage type side effects:
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 22. 应用伤害类型的副作用：

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: * Kinetic damage may cause knockback.

(Note to vi-key users: Forcing a melee attack this way using vi-keys is not possible because the commands overlap with part swapping, use 'f' to enter targeting mode instead, or force melee mode via the Special Commands interface (Spacebar).
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 近战武器只能攻击相邻目标，而且一次只能使用一件。启用近战武器后撞向（移动到）目标即可攻击。也可以左键点击目标本身或目标的大致方向。若要强制近战攻击（通常仅在用近战武器攻击地形或机器时才需要），可按住Ctrl-Shift并朝某方向移动。（vi键用户注意：由于指令与部件更换冲突，不能用vi键强制近战；请改按‘f’进入瞄准模式，或通过特殊指令界面（空格键）启用强制近战模式。）

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Melee attacks use the same hit chance calculations as ranged combat, with a few exceptions:
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 近战攻击使用与远程战斗相同的命中率计算，但有几个例外：

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: All melee weapons benefit from greater momentum in the direction of the attack. Moving multiple consecutive spaces in a row prior to an attack adds additional momentum, up to a maximum of 3. Current momentum is displayed as a number at the end of the HUD's movement data readout.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 所有近战武器都会受益于朝攻击方向积累的更大动量。攻击前连续移动多格会增加动量，最高为3。当前动量以数字显示在HUD移动数据读数末尾。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: The damage bonus on a successful melee hit is +1~40% for non-piercing weapons, or +2~80% for piercing weapons, calculated as: ([momentum] * [speed%] / 1200) * 40). For piercing attacks the multiplier is 80 instead of 40. Speed% is current speed as a percentage of average speed, 100. Thus the more momentum and speed with which you attack, the greater the damage. Your status page shows the damage bonus taking current momentum into account. Note that while some utilities help increase momentum, the maximum bonus damage for a given weapon type cannot be exceeded.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 成功近战命中的伤害加成为：非穿刺武器+1~40%，穿刺武器+2~80%，计算公式为（[动量]*[速度%]/1200）*40。穿刺攻击的乘数为80而非40。速度%是当前速度相对于平均速度100的百分比。因此攻击时动量越大、速度越快，伤害越高。状态页会显示计入当前动量后的伤害加成。某些工具虽能提高动量，但特定武器类型的最高伤害加成不会因此突破上限。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Stopping, performing a non-movement action, or otherwise moving in a direction that does not match the current momentum resets your momentum to 0, except when moving diagonally in the same general direction (e.g. turning from southeast to south). The latter case instead reduces total momentum by 1. Also note that technically any melee attack can take advantage of previously accumulated momentum, regardless of direction. For example, approaching the southern side of a target from the east and attacking northward while passing below it will apply whatever momentum value is displayed in the HUD.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 停止移动、执行非移动行动，或朝与当前动量不符的方向移动，都会将动量重置为0；但若朝大致相同方向斜向移动（例如从东南转向南），则只会令总动量减少1。请注意，理论上任何近战攻击都能利用此前累积的动量，无论攻击方向如何。例如，从目标东侧接近，再从其下方经过并向北攻击，都会应用HUD显示的当前动量值。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Melee attacking an enemy that has not yet noticed you gives a base hit chance of 120%, and a +100% damage bonus which stacks with any momentum bonus. Sneak attacks work on any non-fleeing neutral targets as well, since they don't expect you'll suddenly attack them!
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 近战攻击尚未察觉你的敌人时，基础命中率为120%，并有+100%伤害加成，可与动量加成叠加。偷袭也适用于未逃跑的中立目标，因为它们没想到你会突然动手！

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Although only one primary melee weapon can be active at a time, other attached but inactive melee weapons have a chance to carry out "follow-up attacks" alongside the primary weapon. In Tactical HUD mode, that chance is shown next to each applicable melee weapon. Follow-up attacks are more likely when the primary weapon is slower than a given backup melee weapon. The chance may also be affected by supporting utilities.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 同一时间只能启用一件主要近战武器，但其他已安装、未启用的近战武器也有几率与主武器同时发动“追击攻击”。战术HUD模式下，各适用近战武器旁会显示该几率。若主武器比某件备用近战武器慢，则更容易触发追击攻击。辅助工具也可能影响几率。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Multiple follow-up attacks by different melee weapons are possible in the same action. Each weapon is checked separately, and once confirmed any follow-up attack has a +10% to hit the target. Each weapon incurs no additional time cost to attack aside from modifying the total attack time by half of their time delay (whether positive or negative). Momentum bonuses that apply to the primary weapon all apply to follow-up attacks as well. The benefits of all actuators also apply to every follow-up attack. If the target is destroyed by an earlier attack, any remaining follow-up attacks will switch to another target in range if there is one.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 同一行动中，可能由不同近战武器发动多次追击攻击。每件武器分别判定；确认触发后，该次追击攻击命中目标的几率+10%。追击攻击不额外消耗时间，但会按各武器时间延迟的一半（无论正负）修正总攻击时间。适用于主武器的动量加成也适用于追击攻击。所有致动器的效果同样适用于每次追击攻击。若目标被先前攻击摧毁，剩余追击攻击会改打射程内的其他目标（若有）。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Datajacks cannot be involved in follow-up attacks, and these attacks are only applicable against robot targets.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 数据接驳器不能发动追击攻击；此类攻击也只能针对机器人目标。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: As a last resort, Cogmind can ram other robots to damage and/or push them out of the way. Damage is a random amount from 0 to (((10 + [mass]) / 5) + 1) * ([speed%] / 100) * [momentum], where speed% is current speed as a percentage of average speed (100) and effective momentum is a combination of both Cogmind and the target's momentum. However, the damage per attack is capped at 100 before the roll. Smashing into a robot headed straight for you can deal some serious damage, though there are serious negative consequences to go with this unarmed attack, and half as much damage is inflicted on Cogmind as well. Ramming enables the collection of a small random amount of matter per collision.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 作为最后手段，Cogmind可以撞击其他机器人以造成伤害和/或将其推开。伤害为0至公式((((10+[质量])/5)+1)*([速度%]/100)*[动量])之间的随机值，其中速度%是当前速度相对平均速度100的百分比，有效动量综合Cogmind与目标双方的动量。不过，每次攻击在随机判定前最多按100点伤害计算。迎面撞上正朝你冲来的机器人会造成严重伤害，但这种徒手攻击也有严重负面后果：Cogmind自身会受到一半伤害。每次碰撞还可收集少量随机物质。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Ramming with active treads or legs always avoids self-damage and destabilization. Treads have a per-tread chance to instantly crush targets of medium size and below which have no more than 50 remaining core integrity. Crushed robots have their salvage modified by -20. Legs have a 20% chance per leg to kick the target out of the way. (Not applicable against huge targets.)
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 启用履带或腿时，撞击不会令自身受伤或失衡。每条履带都有几率瞬间碾碎中型及以下、核心剩余完整度不超过50的目标。被碾碎的机器人回收修正为-20。每条腿有20%几率将目标踢开。（对巨型目标无效。）

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: The time cost to ram is the greater (slower) of 100 and your current move speed.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 撞击耗时取当前移动速度和100中较大（较慢）的值。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: It is also possible to ram non-robot targets including walls and machines by using the "force melee attack" command (Ctrl-Shift + Movement Keys, or Ctrl-Shift+LMB) without any active melee weapons. The expected result will be indicated via the usual collision warning when you attempt to ram. The type of propulsion does not affect the results, beyond the indirect effects of carrying capacity and speed. To repeatedly force melee by simply moving into a valid target (or make such an attack compatible with vi-keys), you can toggle force melee mode via the Special Commands interface (Spacebar) or Shift-Alt-e.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 即使没有启用近战武器，也可用“强制近战攻击”指令（Ctrl-Shift+方向键，或Ctrl-Shift+鼠标左键）撞击非机器人目标，包括墙壁和机器。此类撞击使用上述相同伤害公式，但结果总是取最大值，因此可提前判断伤害是否足以摧毁目标。尝试撞击时，常规碰撞警告会显示预期结果。请注意，撞击固体远比撞击机器人危险：Cogmind会承受与目标相同的伤害，还会受到其他负面副作用。推进器类型不会影响结果，但承重和速度带来的间接影响除外。若想通过直接撞向有效目标来反复强制近战（或让该攻击兼容vi键），可通过特殊指令界面（空格键）或Shift-Alt-e切换强制近战模式。

X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 武器伤害分为7种主要类型，每种都有独特属性和效果。旅途中还可能发现其他较少见的类型。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Thermal energy weapons generally have a shorter range, but benefit from a more easily predictable damage potential and little or no recoil. Thermal damage also generally transfers heat to the target, and may cause meltdowns in hot enough targets.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 热能武器通常射程较短，但伤害较易预测，且后坐力很小或没有。热能伤害通常也会向目标传递热量；目标温度足够高时可能熔毁。

Some kinetic projectiles, especially hypervelocity variants, are capable of penetrating one or more consecutive targets. Kinetic cannon hits also blast usable matter off target robots and have a damage-equivalent chance to cause knockback, with a (10 - range) * 5 modifier and a +/-10% per size class (T/S/M/L/H) difference between the target and medium size (targets knocked into another robot may also damage and displace it, see Impact below). The amount of matter created per cannon projectile impact is randomized from between zero up to the absolute value of the weapon's salvage modifier, but only applies for those weapons with a negative salvage modifier below -2.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 弹道武器通常有效射程更远、暴击破坏力更强，但伤害较难预测且后坐力较大。部分动能投射物，尤其是超高速型号，能穿透一个或多个连续目标。动能加农炮命中还会从目标机器人身上轰出可用物质，并有与伤害等效的击退几率；击退几率修正为（10-射程）*5，目标与中型之间每差一个体型等级（T/S/M/L/H）再修正±10%（被撞进另一机器人的目标也可能伤害并推开对方，见下文“冲击”）。每枚加农炮投射物命中产生的物质量为0至武器回收修正绝对值之间的随机数，但仅适用于回收修正低于-2的武器。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Electromagnetic (EM) weapons have less of an impact on integrity, but are capable of corrupting a target's computer systems. Anywhere from 50 to 150% of damage done is also applied as system corruption. (Cogmind is less susceptible to EM-caused corruption, but still has a damage% chance to suffer 1 point of system corruption per hit.) EM-based explosions only deal half damage to inactive items lying on the ground, but can also corrupt them.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 电磁（EM）武器对完整度的影响较小，但能腐化目标的计算机系统。造成伤害的50%至150%也会转化为系统腐化。（Cogmind较不易受电磁腐化影响，但每次命中仍有等同伤害百分比的几率受到1点系统腐化。）电磁爆炸对地上未启用物品只造成一半伤害，但也能腐化它们。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Some EM weapons cause "disruption", which is a per-shot chance to temporarily disable an active part on impact. If a robot core is struck, there is half this chance the entire robot may be disabled. While disrupted a robot may be rewired by bumping into it (see Hacking Robots).
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 部分电磁武器会造成“扰乱”：每次射击命中时都有几率暂时停用一个活动部件。若击中机器人核心，则整台机器人被停用的几率为前者的一半。机器人被扰乱时，可撞击它来重接线路（见“黑入机器人”）。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: While powerful, explosives generally spread damage across each target in the area of effect, dividing damage into separate chunks before affecting a robot, where each chunk selects its own target part (though they may overlap).
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 爆炸武器威力强大，但通常会将范围内每个目标受到的伤害分散：先把伤害分成几份，再分别作用于机器人，每份各自选择目标部件（可能重复命中）。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Explosions also tend to reduce the amount of salvage remaining after destroying a target, and sometimes cause cave-ins in non-reinforced areas.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 爆炸也往往会减少摧毁目标后剩余的可回收物，并有时会导致未加固区域塌方。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Impact melee weapons have a damage-equivalent chance to cause knockback, with a +/-10% per size class (T/S/M/L/H) difference between attacker and target. Targets knocked into another robot may also damage and displace it. A robot hit by another displaced robot has a chance to itself be displaced and sustain damage, where the chance equals the original knockback chance further modified by +/-10% per size class difference between the blocking robot and the knocked back robot, and the resulting damage equals [originalDamage] (see Attack Resolution), further divided by the blocker size class if that class is greater than 1 (where Medium = 2, and so on).
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 冲击类近战武器有与伤害等效的击退几率，攻击者与目标每差一个体型等级（T/S/M/L/H）会修正±10%。被击退的目标撞上另一机器人时，也可能伤害并推动对方。被另一台移动中的机器人撞到后，机器人自身也可能被推开并受伤；几率等于原始击退几率，再按挡路机器人与被击退机器人每差一个体型等级修正±10%。伤害等于[originalDamage]（见“攻击结算”）；若挡路机器人体型大于1，还要再除以其体型等级（中型=2，依此类推）。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Impact weapons ignore relative coverage when determining which components to affect, and are therefore effective at destroying fragile systems regardless of armor and other protection. By ignoring coverage, there is an equal chance for an attack to hit any given part, where each slot of a multislot part also has a separate and equivalent chance to be hit. A target's core also counts as one slot for that purpose. In addition, for every component crushed by an impact, its owner's system is significantly corrupted (+25-150%), though electromagnetic resistance can help mitigate this effect. (Cogmind is less susceptible to corruption caused in this manner.)
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 冲击武器判定命中部件时忽略相对覆盖率，因此不论装甲和其他防护如何，都擅长摧毁脆弱系统。忽略覆盖率后，每个部件被击中的几率相等；多槽部件的每个槽位也分别拥有相同几率。目标核心也视为一个槽位。此外，每件被冲击压碎的部件都会使所属机器人的系统严重腐化（+25-150%），但电磁抗性可以减轻该效果。（Cogmind较不易受到此类腐化。）

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Slashing melee weapons are generally very damaging, and most are also capable of severing components from a target without destroying them.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 劈砍类近战武器通常伤害很高，多数还能够切断目标部件而不将其摧毁。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Piercing melee weapons inflict less collateral damage, but are more likely to hit a robot's core, and get double the melee momentum damage bonus.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 穿刺类近战武器的附带伤害较低，但更容易命中机器人核心，且近战动量伤害加成翻倍。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Movement, firing weapons, and running power sources and some utilities generates heat, as does being hit by thermal weapons. Some of this heat is naturally dissipated by the core's own heat sinks, but not enough to deal with heat generated by numerous/large energy weapons. Heat sinks and cooling systems can be used to avoid overheating, which can have a wide range of negative effects. Heat is only a significant issue for robots that rely heavily on energy weapons. However, note that when firing a volley the heat produced is averaged over the volley's turn duration rather than being immediately applied all at once.

X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 物质：若已安装并启用的现场回收单元正在处理物质，括号内先显示每回合释放量，再显示剩余待处理总量。背包容器中储存的物质总量会在末尾“I:”标记后显示。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Temperature: Like energy, this gives total values under stationary and mobile conditions. If any active coolant injectors are attached, their combined dissipation is shown as a third value.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 温度：与能源类似，显示静止和移动情况下的总值。若安装了活动冷却剂注射器，还会显示第三个数值，代表其合计散热量。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Movement: The time cost per move is shown in parenthesis, followed by a single digit that represents your current momentum. The base momentum factor usually ranges from 0 to 3, and is increased by repeated movement in the same direction. Higher momentum confers a bonus to melee and ramming damage, thus you'll see your current momentum reflected on the status window damage modifier list.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 移动：括号中显示每格移动耗时，后面跟一个数字，表示当前动量。基础动量通常为0至3，朝同一方向连续移动会增加动量。动量越高，近战和撞击伤害加成越大，因此当前动量也会反映在状态窗口的伤害修正列表中。

X0-1V1 turns hostiles against one anothe: Hovering over objects displays their basic data here. For robots the top block color reflects their current integrity, the bottom block color indicates their current heat level (not shown when temperature is cool), while the color of the name indicates their current relation with you: red for hostile, gray for neutral, and green for friendly. When spotted by a hostile, a red '!' appears in the bottom left corner. When a robot has some dialogue that requires you to be adjacent or bump into them to hear, a green '?' is shown there instead. The '?' instead appears gray if you've already collected the associated lore and listening to them does not offer any repeat per-run benefits.
X0-1V1使敌人互相攻击: 将光标悬停在物体上时，这里会显示其基本数据。对于机器人，顶部色块表示当前完整度，底部色块表示当前热量（温度较低时不显示）；名称颜色表示与你的关系：红色为敌对、灰色为中立、绿色为友好。敌人发现你时，左下角会出现红色“!”。若机器人有必须相邻或撞上才能听到的对话，则会显示绿色“?”。若你已收集相关传说，且再次聆听不会带来本局额外收益，“?”会变为灰色。
